inputs.story: Help the Secretary of State sort out which of her diplomats she needs to send out next. Determine the month and destination of each diplomat, and the duration of their visit. Remember, as with all grid-based logic puzzles, no option in any category will ever be used more than once.
inputs.constraints:
1. The ambassador with the 9 day visit will leave sometime after Fitzgerald.
2. Quinn will leave 2 months after Bender.
3. The person leaving in January is either the ambassador with the 3 day visit or Fitzgerald.
4. Quinn will leave 1 month before the ambassador with the 7 day visit.
inputs.constants:
diplomats: Bender; Fitzgerald; Owens; Quinn.
months: January; February; March; April.
durations: 2 day; 3 day; 7 day; 9 day.
inputs.solution:
diplomats	months	durations
fitzgerald	february	2 day
bender	january	3 day
owens	april	7 day
quinn	march	9 day

2. Add double quotes around all constants of the same category.
